bonusGuide.title: How rewards work
bonusGuide.intro: There are four reward types. Referral pays when a qualifying order is completed. Team, loyalty, and global settle at month end. The promotion ladder (Distributor and above) is for selling partners only.
bonusGuide.referralBody: When someone you invited completes an order of NT$2,000 or more, you earn a referral % — as long as you have a buyer account. Any registered buyer can receive referral earnings.
bonusGuide.referralNote: From Tong Tai (level 6) upward, referral is capped at 10%.
bonusGuide.teamBody: At month end you earn the difference between your team % and the % of people directly under you, based on network sales volume. Your own purchases are not included.
bonusGuide.loyaltyBody: If your personal completed purchases reach at least NT$2,000 every month for 12 months in a row, you receive a NT$28,000 loyalty bonus.
bonusGuide.globalBody: Each month, 2% of platform sales goes into a shared pool. It is split among members who reach the levels below. If a level has no one, that share stays with the company.
bonusGuide.globalNote: Higher levels can qualify for more than one share band. Empty bands are kept by the company.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.heading: Curating Quality for Modern Living
aboutPage.paragraph1: MQ was founded on a simple belief: everyday objects should be beautiful, functional, and built to last. We hand-select every item in our collection — from accessories and apparel to home goods and tech essentials.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Our team travels the world to discover makers and brands that share our commitment to craftsmanship, sustainability, and thoughtful design.
aboutPage.inspirationDesc: We believe great design should be accessible. MQ bridges the gap between premium quality and everyday affordability.
aboutPage.visionText: To be the most trusted destination for curated lifestyle goods worldwide.
aboutPage.missionText: To connect people with products that elevate their daily experience.
aboutPage.supportText: Dedicated customer care, hassle-free returns, and transparent sourcing.
aboutPage.submitTaskDesc: Tell us what you're looking for and our curators will find it.
aboutPage.sendMessageDesc: Reach out anytime — we respond within 24 hours.
aboutPage.trustedExperienceDesc: Over a decade of curating quality goods for modern living.
aboutPage.weLoveToHear: We'd love to hear from you.

contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.addressContent:

New York, NY 10001

faqsPage.title: FAQs
faqsPage.a1: We offer hassle-free returns within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return.
faqsPage.a2: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping (1–2 days) is available at checkout. Free shipping on orders over NT$75.
faqsPage.a3: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination.
faqsPage.q4: How can I track my order?
faqsPage.a4: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track orders from your account dashboard.
faqsPage.supportDesc: We're here to help 7 days a week
faqsPage.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faqsPage.a5: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We also offer Klarna and Afterpay for flexible payments.
faqsPage.a6: Every product in our collection is 100% authentic. We work directly with brands and authorized distributors to ensure quality and authenticity.
faqsPage.q7: Can I modify or cancel my order?
faqsPage.a7: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact support and we'll do our best to help.
faqsPage.a8: Yes! Select gift wrapping at checkout for $5. Our premium MQ gift boxes are also available for select items.

portfolioPage.title: Portfolio
portfolioPage.intro: A showcase of MQ projects — from retail experiences to brand campaigns and product collaborations.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.introText: MQ ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or make a purchase.
privacyPage.collectText: We may collect personal information including your name, email address, shipping address, payment information, and browsing behavior on our site.
privacyPage.useText: We use your information to process orders, communicate with you about your purchases, improve our services, and send marketing communications (with your consent).
privacyPage.securityText: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.
privacyPage.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at privacy@mq.com to exercise these rights.
privacyPage.contactText: For questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@mq.com.

iconBoxPage.securePaymentDesc: Your payment information is encrypted and processed through trusted payment gateways.

iconBoxPage.support247Desc: Our customer support team is available around the clock to assist you.
iconBoxPage.premiumQualityDesc: Every item is inspected and verified before it reaches your hands.
iconBoxPage.giftReadyDesc: Beautiful MQ packaging included with every order. Perfect for gifting.

tabsPage.detailsContent: Materials: Premium grade. Origin: Ethically sourced. Warranty: 1 year manufacturer warranty on all tech products. Care: See individual product pages.

accordionPage.title: Accordion
accordionPage.a1: Every product is hand-selected by our curation team. We prioritize quality materials, ethical sourcing, and timeless design over trends.
accordionPage.q2: How do I care for my products?
accordionPage.a2: Each product page includes specific care instructions. Generally, we recommend following the manufacturer's guidelines and storing items properly.
accordionPage.a3: Yes! Our flagship showroom is open Mon–Sat in New York. Book an appointment through our contact page for a personalized shopping experience.
